name: Tenshi ni Natta Karera no Ohanashi
original_name: 天使になった彼らのお話
source:
This is a story from "angel" to "you"
Embracing the regrets of life in my chest

The young man was newly born as an "angel"

He wants to change

The young man decides to move forward

With important friends-
